request: Write a design doc for this feature from my notes. The readers are the backend team, who review it before anyone starts the work.
input:
Notes for the invoice export feature, from the planning call and Slack, 2026-11-14

- support: 40 tickets in October 2026 with the tag "export" (Zendesk report, Minh pulled it). customers ask for all their invoices in one file
- today the only way is the API, 100 invoices per page. biggest customers have up to 120,000 invoices
- idea: async export job. customer clicks Export, we build a CSV in the background, put it in S3, email a link. link expires after 24 hours
- NOT doing: PDF export, scheduled exports, export of objects other than invoices
- other ideas we talked about: a sync download button (fine for small accounts, will time out for big ones), or keep telling people to use the API
- nobody knows how long a 120k export takes. Huy thinks it's fine but nobody tested it. we need a spike before we commit
- we assume the S3 bucket in us-east-1 is ok for EU customers. nobody asked legal about data residency yet
- target from Minh: export tickets below 10 per month after launch
- cost and eng time: no idea yet, Minh will ask Huy
- rollout: behind the flag invoice_export, beta with 5 customers first, then everyone. turn the flag off to go back
- open: finance wants a tax ID column, unclear if every invoice has one
- (Lan: who's in for pho on friday?)
